metadata.case_name: TALAT ARSLAN v. LI TAK CHEUNG

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: lighter duties such as restroom attendant, fuel station worker, cashier or office light cleansing worker

injuries.description: skin laceration over the right eyebrow and right face
source: After the accident, Mr Arslan was admitted to the A&E Department of Pok Oi Hospital where he was found to be stable but suffering from skin laceration over the right eyebrow and right face, posterior displacement of the lumbar vertebrae at level L2 and L3, and local tenderness at the lumbar region.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: closed fracture of the left acetabulum
source: He was then transferred to the Tuen Mun Hospital on the same day to be diagnosed of a closed fracture of the left acetabulum, a fracture of the lumbar spine at the L2/L3 level, a dislocation at the L5/S1 level, and a fracture of proximal phalanx of the left ring finger.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of acetabulum without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: posterior displacement of the lumbar vertebrae at level L2 and L3
source: After the accident, Mr Arslan was admitted to the A&E Department of Pok Oi Hospital where he was found to be stable but suffering from skin laceration over the right eyebrow and right face, posterior displacement of the lumbar vertebrae at level L2 and L3, and local tenderness at the lumbar region.

He was then transferred to the Tuen Mun Hospital on the same day to be diagnosed of a closed fracture of the left acetabulum, a fracture of the lumbar spine at the L2/L3 level, a dislocation at the L5/S1 level, and a fracture of proximal phalanx of the left ring finger.
injuries.icd_description: Dislocation of other or unspecified parts of lumbar spine or pelvis without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: fracture of proximal phalanx of the left ring finger
source: He was then transferred to the Tuen Mun Hospital on the same day to be diagnosed of a closed fracture of the left acetabulum, a fracture of the lumbar spine at the L2/L3 level, a dislocation at the L5/S1 level, and a fracture of proximal phalanx of the left ring finger.

injuries.description: 23 cm long scar extending from L1 to S2 level of the spine with tenderness at the surrounding areas
source: As for his back, Dr Lau did not find any swelling or deformity but there was a 23 cm long scar extending from L1 to S2 level of the spine with tenderness at the surrounding areas.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: 1 cm scar to the left of the scrotum with tenderness at the nearby region
source: As for the hip, Dr Lau also did not find any swelling or deformity. There was a 1 cm scar to the left of the scrotum similarly with tenderness at the nearby region.
injuries.icd_description: Injury to male genital organ without specification of injury type

injuries.description: multiple scars over his right face and both elbows
source: In the report of Dr Lau dated 2 March 2016, it was recorded that Mr Arslan complained of multiple scars over his right face and both elbows.

manifestations.description: multiple scars over his right face and both elbows
right sided headache once a week which lasted for an hour or so each time
pain in the left finger when holding heavy objects or wringing a towel
continuous low back pain which intensified to grade 8-9/10 when sitting from more than half an hour or lying in bed for long periods
intermittent pain in the left hip at grade 7-8/10 particularly during cold and humid weather, walking for over 10 minutes or climbing stairs
unable to walk on tiptoes or heels
unable to stand on his left leg
no swelling or deformity of back but tenderness at surrounding areas
substantial limitation in the flexion of the spine
Straight leg raising while sitting was 90 degrees on the right side but 70 degrees on the left side
decreased range of movement of the hip on the left with slight muscle wasting of the thigh and calf
mild bony swelling and tenderness over the dorsum of the proximal phalanx; range of movement was found to be normal
able to walk without aid or limp

treatments_received: admitted to A&E and transferred to Tuen Mun Hospital
open reduction with internal fixation of the spine (26 September 2013)
closed reduction with internal fixation for fracture of the left acetabulum (26 September 2013)
removal of metal implant at the spine (October 2014)

losses.description: multiple scars over his right face and both elbows; 23 cm long scar extending from L1 to S2 level of the spine; 1 cm scar to the left of the scrotum

inability to squat; unable to walk on tiptoes or heels; unable to stand on left leg; decreased range of movement of the left hip; intermittent left hip pain on walking over 10 minutes or climbing stairs
unable to resume pre-accident occupation as a construction worker

comparable_cases.case_name: Ku Chiu Chung Woody v Tang Tin Sung
comparable_cases.injury_description: close fracture of the left acetabulum with dislocation of the left hip, open fracture of the left proximal tibia, open complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament of the left knee, open partial tear of the lateral meniscus of the left knee and a closed fracture of the shaft of the left tibia. Open reduction of the left hip and internal fixation of the left acetabular fracture, open reduction and internal fixation of the left proximal tibia, closed reduction of the tibia shaft fracture with external fixator were performed. Further repeated operations for the adjustment of the tibial shaft fracture were carried out at a later stage and the plaintiff was discharged about 1.5 months after the accident.

comparable_cases.case_name: Cheng Chi Hong v Lo Chi Hung
comparable_cases.injury_description: right hip dislocation, a fracture of the right femoral head and a laceration over the right eye. Open reduction was performed at the hip together with a removal of a bone fragment, and the laceration was sutured. The plaintiff developed mild degeneration at L4/L5 and L5/S1 levels and a mild disc protrusion at the L4/L5 level about 11 months later.

comparable_cases.case_name: Cheung Kwok Keung v Yip Man Hing Building Materials Company Limited and Others
comparable_cases.injury_description: Garden type IV comminuted fracture of the right hip; after closed reduction with screw fixation displacement required a second closed reduction and internal fixation; later screws removed and hip arthroscopy performed; plaintiff walked with elbow crutches on discharge.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Long Kin v Lam Kam Cheong
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractures of the right superior pubic ramus, L5 lumbar vertebrae transverse process, left distal fibula, and a soft tissue injury to the left shoulder. Open reduction internal fixation operation on the ankle was performed; plaintiff was discharged 16 days after the accident and developed mild adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety.
